title: Tell an operator when the report worker is stuck
author: sam-fixture
body:
`GET /health` stays green when the report worker has stopped making progress, so nothing alerts anyone. docs/operations.md says as much.

Proposal: a second probe, or a field on the existing one, that reports how long the oldest queued report has been waiting.

Open question: should a stuck worker make the load balancer take the instance out of rotation? Probably not, since task requests still work.
